speaker: hero
text: Bit, my boss sent a nine-hundred-word *email*.

speaker: bit
text: And you read it three times. Still *lost*.

speaker: hero
text: Can you just tell me what he *wants*?

speaker: bit
text: Better. I'll show you how to ask *any* AI.

speaker: bit
text: Step one. Paste the whole email. Don't *summarize* it yourself.

speaker: bit
text: Step two. Ask three questions. *Not* summarize this.

speaker: bit
text: What do they want from me?

speaker: hero
text: Why not just ask for a *summary*?

speaker: bit
text: A summary is shorter. Questions give you the next *move*.

speaker: hero
text: Nine hundred words. And it's just: report by *Friday*?

speaker: bit
text: Step three. Before you send, check names, dates and *numbers*.

speaker: bit
text: AI can mix them up. That part is *your* job.

speaker: hero
text: Bit. The boss just sent a *second* email.

speaker: bit
text: It says: thanks for the *fast reply*.

speaker: bit
text: Follow for one AI trick a day.
